vb_textbox.text: I would advice to stick with brighter colours and purple as your primary colour group when choosing a colour each round to begin with. Begin with these colours in each round until you notice the amount decreases each round when picking a colour from that group. At that point, switch to the other color/color group which would be the darker or pink color. There might be some rounds where the best choices do alternate so its better to experiment in that case and stick to which group gives the higher return then repeat the process
